Primary action: D (retain local diagnosis only; defer run-ahead screening). Narrowest supported role: retrospective diagnosis of the development executions bound to the incumbent reference — not prospective validation and not a screening mandate. I acknowledge BOTH a material scalar numerical-resolution contribution AND uncorrected vector error, so no convergence, promotion or causal claim is warranted.

Coarse production reproduction is essentially exact: at .30–.31 s the saved states reproduce to position 2.618125142092799e-11 / 9.192850617016396e-10 m and velocity 2.6184579927347476e-09 / 9.196761137540435e-08 m/s; saved production defects are 5.0952387057809356e-8 and 1.9131447419756277e-6, so those tiny offsets do not explain the residual. Initial errors are already large: position norms .0026891778822236262 / .0026889844817533045 m, initial velocity vector norms .00037922371316335865 / .00036431540818624943 m/s; endpoint vector velocity errors reach .007492333503420177 / .006934123087733086 m/s, and change errors .0072664637497075425 / .006759890279313809 m/s. Refinement from .01 to .001 s DOES help scalar speed: +.00165639008211407 / +.00109026085753176 m/s, cutting scalar endpoint speed error ~26.16% / ~20.99%, yet the residual stays >40× the 1e-4 m/s tolerance. Vector error is not consistently improved: for .15 the .01→.001 span moves .006934196218480314 -> .007222011082626113 m/s, with the .002 value .007142183950770937. Fine differences .0002074082261871897 / .000129349605445708 are .001-minus-.002 (not fine-minus-coarse). No uniquely proven projection-level physical cause exists; a single finer value is not convergence.

At .30 s the common feasible regenerated cold seed satisfies weight-independent checks: objective ~.13, scaled violation 5.2794479400188055e-12, max position error 0.0013601908212322671 < .005 m and speed 0.01991554683358343 < .02 m/s; all three weights share identical first_command_n because the callback stops at iteration zero (selected_plan_is_seed) before any weight-dependent update. These production history/state/input/solver paths differ from the diagnostic, and exact historical warm plans are absent, so no warm-start-only attribution is possible.

Safety: .075/.15 predictions remain false-safe — predicted .016953566461155 < .02 while observed .023285947509969908 > .02, and the .001 result .01860995697336772 is still false-safe. Production acceptance is position .01 m, speed .02 m/s; numerical reporting tolerance is 1e-4 m/s.
